build: Assurance Regent v6.3.19 + selective ADRA-only features
merge_policy: Preserve v6.3.19 auth/sign-up/sign-in/voice/Recovery Agent; add non-duplicate ADRA capabilities selectively.
supabase_note: New SQL migrations and Edge Functions are included in the repository but were not applied to a live project.

post_merge_fixes.issue: Duplicate Registered country controls in company profile editor
post_merge_fixes.resolution: v6.3.124 country selector is the single visible authority; the legacy v6.3.113 picker is suppressed while the native select remains synchronized.
verified_behaviour: selection updates the native country value

post_merge_fixes.issue: Developer unable to change an existing registered country
post_merge_fixes.resolution: Developer-only country changes are permitted, confirmed in the UI, persisted by the Supabase RPC, mirrored to compatibility country fields, and audit-tracked in registrationHistory.
verified_behaviour: old immutable-country SQL guard removed from consolidated setup scripts

post_merge_fixes.issue: Registered country options panel could render behind the Edit company details modal
post_merge_fixes.resolution: The v6.3.124 selector now opens its options panel as a manual Popover top-layer surface in supported browsers, with an open-dialog fallback for older browsers.
verified_behaviour: Zambia remains the selected value until changed
country options surface is configured for modal top-layer display

country_selector.top_layer_mechanism: HTML Popover API (manual), with open-dialog fallback
